cases.question: How many weeks in 2025 did Memphis DC have stockouts?
cases.sql:
SELECT "t1"."warehouse", SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(2 * "t1"."zero_rows" AS BIGINT) >= "t1"."total_rows" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "stockout_weeks", MIN(CASE WHEN CAST(2 * "t1"."zero_rows" AS BIGINT) >= "t1"."total_rows" THEN "t1"."d_week_seq" - "t4"."first_seq" + 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "first_week", MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(2 * "t1"."zero_rows" AS BIGINT) >= "t1"."total_rows" THEN "t1"."d_week_seq" - "t4"."first_seq" + 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "last_week"
